$schema_notes: Hand-curated scenarios derived from the project tracking spreadsheet:
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/14mnRcgRWvF_MhUEFLSDegDDVFlvAN86JY32E8EZWmDI
A scenario is a named, ordered sequence of Playwright steps that exercises
an end-to-end workflow. The runner (verify-scenarios.js) executes them one
step at a time, recording per-step PASS/FAIL plus an overall verdict.
Scenario fields:
id           — kebab-case stable identifier (used in result diffs)
name         — human-readable scenario name
description  — one sentence describing what this validates
area         — feature area used for grouping in the dashboard
auth         — true if the steps require a pre-authenticated session.
When auth=true and no auth-state.json is present, the
runner marks the scenario as skipped (it does NOT log in)
steps        — ordered list of step objects (see Step Kinds below)
Step Kinds:
goto           { kind, path }
Navigate to CONFIG.BASE_URL + path. Waits for
DOMContentLoaded.
click          { kind, selector?, text? }
Click an element. Provide EITHER a CSS/Playwright
selector OR a text string (matched via getByText).
fill           { kind, selector, value }
Fill an input. The value may be a placeholder:
$EMAIL    -> CONFIG.TEST_EMAIL
$PASSWORD -> CONFIG.TEST_PASSWORD
expect_text    { kind, text, timeout_ms? }
Assert text is visible anywhere on the page.
expect_url     { kind, contains }
Assert the current URL contains the given substring.
expect_visible { kind, selector, timeout_ms? }
Assert an element matching the selector is visible.
wait           { kind, ms }
Pause for ms milliseconds (use sparingly).
Note on selectors: these are best-effort guesses based on the visible app
shape (MUI components, navbar 'Log in' button, text-based links). Run
verify:scenarios and refine selectors when steps fail for selector reasons
rather than real product bugs.

scenarios.name: Email login via navbar modal
scenarios.description: Open the navbar login modal, submit credentials, confirm the modal closes and the session is authenticated.

scenarios.name: Home to Browse Tasks
scenarios.description: Land on the home page and navigate into the Browse Tasks list.

scenarios.name: Browse Tasks search input present
scenarios.description: Visit the Browse Tasks page and verify a search input is present and usable.

scenarios.name: Task creation form loads
scenarios.description: Authenticated user can open the post-task form and see editable inputs.

steps.selector: form input, form textarea, input, textarea, .MuiInputBase-input

scenarios.name: Favorites list opens
scenarios.description: Authenticated user can navigate to their favorites page and see the results heading.

scenarios.name: Browse Services page loads
scenarios.description: Visit the Browse Services page and verify a list/grid renders.

scenarios.name: View Profile
scenarios.description: Authenticated user can open their profile page and see the profile container.

scenarios.name: Edit Profile form is editable
scenarios.description: Authenticated user can reach the account settings page and see at least one editable input.

steps.selector: form input:not([disabled]):not([readonly]), form textarea:not([disabled]):not([readonly]), input:not([disabled]):not([readonly]), textarea:not([disabled]):not([readonly]), .MuiInputBase-input:not([disabled]):not([readonly])
